title: PIC mode-port networks: straight guide, discontinuity, Y branch and crossing S, reciprocity, passivity with the radiation defect measured

fixture.materials: core permittivity 12, cladding 2.1, guide width 0.4 um, wavelength 1.55 um, 0.5 um z-periodic slab, float32
fixture.straight_guide: tests/test_mode_branches.py: 4.8 x 2.4 x 0.5 um, mesh 0.1 um, x CPML 8 layers, y and z periodic, 600 steps, aperture ports (0, 1.2, 0.5) um at x = -1 and +1 um with source offset 0.4 um; tests/test_mode_network.py: 8 x 1 x 1 um, mesh 0.2 um, 40x5x5 cells, 600 steps, full-cell two-port network
fixture.y_branch_and_crossing_at_0p1um: tests/test_mode_branches.py: 4.8 x 4.8 x 0.5 um, mesh 0.1 um, 48x48x5 cells, x and y CPML 8 layers (0.8 um), 800 steps (152 fs), Y branch with arms moving from y = 0 at x = -0.4 um to y = +-0.7 um at x = 0.6 um and three ports (in at x = -1, up and down at x = +1, y = +-0.7 um); crossing of two 0.4 um guides with four ports at x = +-1 and y = +-1 um; 2-cycle Gaussian plane launch; device cuda when available else cpu

precision: float64 for the Taylor and central-difference checks
backend: cuda for tests/test_mode_branches.py, tests/test_mode_network.py and tests/test_mode_branch_passivity.py when CUDA and CuPy are present, else cpu
reference_method: Physical invariants of a lossless reciprocal structure: reciprocity S_ij = S_ji after unit reduced-power normalisation of every channel at the port phase planes, passivity sum_j |S_ji|^2 <= 1, and the complete channel balance of the Poynting flux through a closed box (incident = reflected + transmitted + side radiation) measured without the modal projection. Straight-guide phase against exp(2 i beta L) from the mode solver's beta (analytic_discrete). Discontinuity |S|^2 against continuum Fresnel R and T and the complex S against an independently coded scalar discrete Yee interface. S^H S = I is never asserted for an open network.

observables.name: column_power
observables.definition: sum over selected guided channels of |S_ji|^2 for each incident channel i (report column_power); the defect 1 - column_power is the power missing from the guided channels

observables.name: flux_closure
observables.definition: sum of the outward Poynting flux fractions through the four box faces (west inward incident counted negative); zero for a closed box when all power has left

observables.name: guided_versus_total
observables.definition: |S_00|^2 against the total reflected fraction 1 + west/incident; sum of arm |S_j0|^2 against the total flux fraction through the arm-carrying faces

observables.name: measured_nonguided
observables.definition: (reflected_total - |S_00|^2) + (transmitted_total - guided transmission) + side radiation; equals the defect minus the closure error identically

observables.name: fresnel_powers
observables.definition: |S_ii|^2 against R = 1/121 and |S_21|^2 against T = 120/121 for the index step 1.0 to 1.2

material_vjp.cpu_float64_taylor: remainder ratio below 0.3 per halving and central difference within 1e-6 relative

acceptance.source_of_limits: completion_gates.json proposed_thresholds lossless_complete_channel_balance_absolute_error 0.01 for the flux closure; the other values are the repository's recorded budgets, all reported here as differences from the program's common criteria where looser

flux closure at the 0.1 um network mesh: the quadrature error alone is 2 percent of the incident power on the crossing (O(h^2), 0.34 percent at 0.05 um), so the 1 percent balance limit is declared at 0.05 um only

error_budget.precision_floor: float32 S entries; reciprocity floors of 5.6e-5 (crossing) to 2.2e-3 (Y branch) at 0.05 um; the staircase Y-branch taper is the dominant asymmetry, not round-off
error_budget.time_window: 0.05 um fixture: 2400 steps (229 fs); the pilot sweep at this commit gave identical closure to five digits at 3200 steps (305 fs); at 0.1 um and 800 steps (152 fs) the Y-branch closure was -2.12 percent falling to -0.64 percent at 1200 steps, so 800 steps is truncation-limited and is kept only for the S-matrix tests
error_budget.pml: 0.8 um CPML fixed; the pilot at 0.1 um with 16 and 24 layers (1.6 and 2.4 um) changed the Y-branch closure by less than 0.15 percentage points, so PML reflection is not the residual
error_budget.mesh: crossing closure -1.97 percent at 0.1 um and -0.34 percent at 0.05 um (O(h^2) flux quadrature); Y-branch closure -0.64 percent at 0.1 um and -0.69 percent at 0.05 um, mesh-, window- and PML-independent and not identified; it lies inside the 1 percent limit and is recorded as an open residual

notes: tests/test_mode_branch_passivity.py is added with this case. Its first draft at mesh 0.1 um and 800 steps with a 2 percent closure budget failed on the Y branch by truncation (-2.12 percent); the sweeps of window, PML depth and mesh listed under error_budget were run before the fixture was fixed at 0.05 um and 2400 steps and judged against the program's 1 percent balance limit. Pilot values at this commit: Y branch column power 0.7234, defect 0.2766, measured nonguided 0.2697, closure -0.688 percent, side radiation 3.53 percent, reciprocity 2.2e-3; crossing column power 0.8054, defect 0.1946, measured nonguided 0.1911, closure -0.344 percent, reciprocity 5.6e-5. The 0.1 um network tests keep their recorded values (Y branch 0.816, 0.549, 0.549; crossing 0.760).
